data.synopsis: The exciting 3D series revolves around the main character Li Bai and focuses on the main theme of "love and homecoming." The story invites the viewer to take an adventurous journey with Li Bai to the city of Chang'an on the mainland of Glory of Kings. The young man investigates, discovers the truth and solves the case of his hometown, the City of Broken Moon, demonstrating the pursuit of truth, goodness and beauty in a positive, courageous and forward-looking spirit. In pursuit of a higher purpose, young Li Bai leaves his family and embarks on a long journey. However, a letter from his family, which affects the wanderer's thoughts of returning to his hometown, brings about a shocking crisis that affects Chang'an.

data.title: Wangu Kuang Di
data.synopsis:
Chu Kuangsheng, son of Patriarch Chu in the remote Shiyang town in Shenlong Empire, was born weak and unable to train. Due to his cultivation impairment, he is the laughingstock of the entire town. Three years ago, his parents go missing while on official duty. His talented and beautiful sister, Chu Liu'er, is the apparent successor to head the Chu family but she suffers a strange illness. Since then, Chu Kuangsheng's situation gets increasingly difficult. During an ambush, the injured Chu Kuangsheng inherits the ancestral technique of Chu family, rebuilding his damaged meridians. From then on, Chu Kuangsheng's training progresses rapidly. 

Despite appearing weak and incompetent on the surface, he has another identity — the renowned Kuangzun in the martial world. Chu Kuangsheng discovers the collusion of the Chu clan leader with outsiders may be related to his parents' disappearance. He uses his hidden identity of Kuangzun to secretly make connections with heroes, accumulating strength and gathering information. With one face and two identities, he eliminates the corrupt individuals in the Chu clan, He then leaves the small town for Siling Academy to train while he investigates and traces the clues to his parents' disappearance. 

Wielding his sword, cutting off the past and battling against heroes in the vast universe, Chu Kuangsheng's name resonates across myriad domains — he becomes the master.

[Written by AnastasiaWun]

data.title: Taigu Xing Shen Jue
data.title_english: The Secrets of Star Divine Arts
data.synopsis:
Chen Xing is the young master of the Chen family in Dongyang City. Both his parents died. He could have succeeded him as the head of the family when he came of age, but was plotted and plotted by the ambitious acting head of the family, Chen Sheng, to occupy the magpie nest. 

Who would have thought that Chen Xing would survive the catastrophe, accidentally obtain the long-lost supreme skill "The Ancient Star God Art", and learn some of the moves, come back strong, expose Chen Sheng's ugly face, and imprison him. The matter was put aside for the time being. Chen Xing took precautions and carefully studied the "Ancient Star God Technique" to collect the star beasts needed for the technique and grow rapidly. 

During this period, Chen Xing rescued Mu Qinglan, the daughter of the palace lord of Xuanyang Palace, because of a star beast, and on her advice, she went through all kinds of hardships to enter Xuanyang Palace. However, as soon as he started, Chen Xing had constant disputes with Jian Feikong, the son of the deputy sect leader.

(Source: Youku, translated)

data.title: Yiren Jun Moxie
data.synopsis:
Jun Xie, a legendary ace agent feared by all, suffered an accident during a mission and was reborn in the Xuanxuan Continent as Jun Moxie, the infamous and utterly useless young master of the Tianxiang Kingdom. His family is now mired in trouble and facing numerous crises. Though his body is now a useless shell, he remains a king in this life, and will continue to do so in this new world! He will roam the martial world, wielding his sword, caring not who reigns supreme; for him, a late-night snack is nothing more than a pot of turtle soup.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

data.title: Da Yuzhou Shidai
data.synopsis:
Earth is facing annihilation due to the appearance of neutron star debris. Led by Yao Yuan, the Black Star Squad takes on the mission of saving humanity's future. Using the spaceship Hope, they evacuate a large number of people from Earth to search for a new home in space. During their adventures and battles, Yao Yuan and his team learn of the existence of more advanced cosmic civilizations and also realize the terrifying truth: the universe is not a paradise, but an unknown realm filled with darkness, danger, death, and terror.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
data.background: Adaptation of zhttty's web novel of the same title.

data.title: Sheng Zu
data.synopsis: Young Luo Lie was accidentally selected to be summoned to the other world to live in the identity of others. The large and small forces in the other world are divided, and there are hidden killing opportunities everywhere. The homesick Luo Lie relied on his tenacious character and mysterious ability acquired when he wore his soul to overcome many difficulties in the treacherous situation, break through his own limits, and make a name for himself. However, the dangerous predicament, treacherous and cunning tricks are pressing on him step by step, with the help of his childhood sweetheart, Luo Lie, who has no intention of becoming a hero, unexpectedly embarked on a heroic road, what awaits him in front of him is the abyss of no return, or the light that clears the clouds and sees the sun?

data.title: Bu Xing Si: Yuanqi
data.synopsis:
Qin fell and Han rose, everything in ruins awaited reconstruction. Scholars retreated to seclusion, clans rose in power. Chariots raced for supremacy, what was the point of the weak fighting? With united hearts and strength, ruler and subject acted in tandem. Heaven bestowed an extraordinary gift, originating from the Gan Star, applied to Yin and Yang, different from stillness and movement. Stillness is the way of Heaven, slow and peaceful; movement is the comradeship, swift as thunder. The plan to capture the star, the heart of strategy. The Gan Star entered the world, creating extraordinary individuals. The treacherous bring ruin to the country, the loyal bring ruin to themselves; those who appear virtuous separate from those who are not, no longer can they be subjects. Deviating from the norm, the world was re-divided. Gathering ferns, gathering ferns, the beginning is like Zhou; gathering ferns, gathering ferns, the beginning is like Qin.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
data.background: Adaptation of Yue Guan's (月关) web novel, Bu Xing Si Zhi Yuanqi (捕星司之源起).

data.title: Harimaware! Koinu
data.title_japanese: 貼りまわれ! こいぬ
data.synopsis:
The story of the series follows Koinu, a serious-minded dog who goes to work one day only to find that his company has gone bankrupt. At a loss, Koinu takes a job from a mysterious recruitment agent and is hired to paste dog stickers all over the city. Even though he doesn't understand the purpose of this strange assignment, Koinu works hard every day at his new employment.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

data.title: Kicks and Punk
data.synopsis:
"Let's go. In search of treasure"
Nike, a punky outsider girl, runs through the city of the future! In a city where the transportation infrastructure has developed dramatically and walking is no longer necessary, Nike runs alone in her favorite sneakers. Her goal is to get sneakers from the legendary manufacturer "Dynameros", which can only be obtained on the black market. As Nike runs despite being chased by a horde of cyber police, a woman appears in front of her. That woman is none other than Sherry, the daughter of the president of "Fractal Walter", a major company that created the era. What kind of story will the encounter between these two opposing people produce?

(Source: Official site, translated)

data.title: Yin Shizong Men Zhang Jiao
data.synopsis:
Jiang Beichen traveled to a fantasy world and accidentally got the strongest master system, and established the "Xiandao Sect". In the early days of the sect, he had to rely on abducting the son of luck to upgrade the sect. Every day, he had to pretend to be a master and bluff a group of talented disciples who admired him. Slowly, Jiang Beichen discovered that his small sect had really become the top hidden sect!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
